sourceReviewMiss: The prior independent source gate missed the NPC before-image coverage and numeric representation defects and the new advance count mismatch. This report records the unexpected failures without reclassifying them as intended causal RED or modifying prior reports.

findings.observed: Both reach completed ordinary reduction; final assembly throws missing exact before-image for game_state/npcs/npc_effects.json.
findings.cause: CreateOrdinaryReductionFixture builds a fixed beforeImages dictionary containing PlayerPath but omitting NpcPath (AcceptedMechanicsReduction.cs:284-295). New scenarios add an actual NPC carrier. Its genuine lifecycle mutation becomes a touched carrier. AssembleCalculatedPlan passes input.BeforeImages unchanged (CommonCalculation.cs:493), and AcceptedMechanicsPlan.ValidatePathCoverage correctly refuses any touched path absent from that map (AcceptedMechanicsPlan.cs:1777-1780).
findings.minimumCorrection: In the new scenario test fixture, before computing planning fingerprint/reduction, capture exact NPC baseline from the genuine initial EffectPlan.CarrierBeforeImages[NpcPath] (or equivalently the configured PreTurnCarriers.NpcEffects). Encode its ToJsonString as UTF8 and add CanonicalBeforeImage(true, bytes) using Input.WithBeforeImage for the missing NPC path. This can stay local to npc_advance/multi_target and preserves shared helper defaults. Assert baseline present and distinct from completed after-image; never use an invented absent NPC root or completed after-image as baseline. If a fixture-level opt-in is chosen, capture actual configured carriers before initial planning and populate present/absent maps there without broad default changes.
findings.guardPreserved: No production before-image/coverage relaxation. WithBeforeImage only adds missing keys; it must not be used to overwrite existing registered PlayerPath.

findings.classification: New assertion contradicts existing actual allocation contract
findings.observed: Actual old common completion and all new ledger/ref/copy/idempotence assertions precede line117, which alone expects1 versus actual2 transition factory calls.
findings.cause: Original fixture retains a deterministic periodic_damage owner_turn_end trigger with consumeUses=false (TestSupport fixture:764-772). Resource acceptance enters Draft NonConsumingTrigger at709 and ApplyNonConsumingTriggerEvidence allocates trigger_execution and records kind trigger (planner:7473-7497). Final lifetime turns advancement independently allocates lifecycle_advance at7062 and records kind consume at7104-7117. These are two legitimate distinct identities, not a ledger second allocation. Nonconsuming helper and scheduler are unchanged from initialcf95; lifecycle allocation line is unchanged by the ledger diff.
findings.minimumCorrection: Expect advance2/no_change0/no_eligible0, keep EffectCalls0 and the existing no-additional-allocation/repeat-completion assertions. Strengthen advance against actual completed identity history: exactly two newly allocated transition IDs, kinds trigger then consume, same actual effect, distinct causal operation refs; final lifecycle ledger transitionRefs contains only the consume ID and excludes the trigger ID. Preserve original periodic damage fixture instead of removing the real trigger.

findings.classification: In-memory numeric representation in new fixture
findings.observed: Initial cache succeeds, but common reduction returns Rejected before helper line311. Raw failure does not print reduction.Issues.
findings.staticCause: Scenario assigns deadline=50, an Int32-backed JsonValue, at LifecycleExecutionLedger.cs:352. Carrier validation serializes to JsonElement (EffectCarrierCatalog.cs:550) and RequireNonNegativeLong uses TryGetInt64 (EffectMaterializationContract.cs:648-661), so validation accepts numeric50. AddOccurrence takes effect.DeepClone (catalog603), initial plan and ResourceTriggerCarriers clone values (EffectAcceptedTurnPlan.cs:304-314,561-566), Draft workspace clones those carriers (Draft476; planner8784-8791), and scheduler clones again. No serializer reparse replaces the retained node. Final AdvanceUntilTime validates deadline using JsonValue.TryGetValue<long> (scheduler775 and1011-1014) before checking absent CurrentTime at783. The Int32 node fails that check: statically expected effect_lifecycle_state_invalid at effect.lifetime.deadline, Actual50. ApplyLifecycleReduction propagates issues; Draft final-lifetime864-866 fails, CompleteCommonMechanics returns those issues at265, and ReduceAcceptedPlan returns Rejected at4337-4339.
findings.evidenceLimit: The rejection and branch are observed/static respectively. Exact issue code is statically determined, not present in frozen failure output, and no runtime probe was run.
findings.minimumCorrection: Change only the fixture deadline literal to50L. Keep accepted lifecycle currentTime absent/null and preserve the no_change, currentTime null and empty transitionRefs assertions. Add explicit fixture precondition that deadline.TryGetValue<long> succeeds. This follows existing EffectLifecycleSchedulerTests.Lifetime.cs:144 using100L and real planner long deadline construction. Do not supply a fake current time, change scheduler guard, remove the scenario or treat its rejection as expected.

findings.cause: Both new completed-kind assertions emit enum values only; until_time raw packet therefore cannot expose causal ValidationIssue data.
findings.minimumCorrection: Retain exact CompletedOrdinaryReduction expectation while adding reduction.Issues code/path/expected/actual to assertion failure text in both the first theory and ReduceLifecycleLedgerFixture. For example Assert.True(reduction.Kind == CompletedOrdinaryReduction, $"Expected CompletedOrdinaryReduction; actual {reduction.Kind}. {DescribeOrdinaryReductionIssues(reduction.Issues)}"). Include FilePath in issue formatter or a ledger-local diagnostic formatter. Do not weaken the precondition.
